get.description: Check if the Track It API backend is active, healthy, and operational.

message.example: Track It Backend API is healthy and running!

post.description: Register a full user account with hashed password and receive an access token.
Authenticate an existing user with email and password to receive a JWT access token.
Create an instant, anonymous guest account for quick evaluation without registration. Returns a valid JWT with role `GUEST`.

get.description: Retrieve profile information of the currently authenticated user or guest.

patch.description: Update personal details such as display name, phone number, and default base currency.

get.description: List all default system categories plus custom categories created by the current user.

post.description: Create a new custom category for the user.

patch.description: Update name, type, or icon of a custom category. System default categories cannot be modified.

404.description: Custom category not found or cannot modify system default category

delete.description: Delete a custom category owned by the user. System default categories cannot be deleted.

404.description: Custom category not found or cannot delete system default category

get.description: Retrieve transactions with filtering by type, category, and date range, alongside pagination and sorting.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Filter transactions on or after this ISO datetime

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Filter transactions on or before this ISO datetime

post.description: Add an income or expense transaction. When an EXPENSE is logged, the monthly budget's spent amount automatically recalculates.

patch.description: Update transaction fields. Recalculates and synchronizes monthly budget spent metrics.

delete.description: Delete a transaction and re-sync the monthly budget's spent amount.

post.description: Set a monthly target budget for a given month in YYYY-MM format. Automatically computes spent amount from all expense transactions in that month.

get.description: Returns budget status, total spent, remaining funds, percentage used, and exceed indicator for the specified month.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Month in YYYY-MM format (defaults to current month if omitted)

get.description: Retrieve user bills with optional filtering by payment status, subscription classification, and due month. (Registered USER only)

post.summary: Add a new bill or recurring subscription
post.description: Create a bill entry with due date, recurrence interval, and reminder threshold. (Registered USER only)

get.description: Scans expense transactions to automatically identify repeated identical amounts or notes indicating hidden recurring subscriptions.
Returns unpaid bills due within the next 7 days along with computed alert text and countdown days.

alert_message.example: Your bill "Electricity" of 85.00 is due in 2 day(s).

patch.description: Modify an existing bill's title, amount, due date, repetition, or status.

delete.description: Delete a bill or subscription record.

patch.description: Convenience endpoint to immediately mark a bill as settled and paid.

get.description: Retrieve all shared expense splits created by the user, including participant details and settlement status.

post.description: Record a bill split with friends or colleagues with individual participant shares.

post.summary: Add participant to an existing split
post.description: Add an additional participant and their share amount to an existing expense split.

patch.description: Mark an individual participant's share as settled. If all participants have settled, the whole split automatically marks as settled.

404.description: Expense split record or participant not found

patch.description: Mark all participants and the entire split record as fully settled.

200.description: Entire expense split settled up successfully

message.example: Entire expense split settled up successfully

get.description: Calculates monthly total income, total expense, net balance, budget details, and category breakdown for visualization.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Month in YYYY-MM format (defaults to current month)

get.description: Generates day-by-day spending metrics and normalized intensity levels (0 = No Spend, 1 = Low, 2 = Medium, 3 = High, 4 = Peak) for GitHub-style calendar heatmaps.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Month in YYYY-MM format (defaults to current month)

get.description: Fetch real-time currency exchange rates relative to a given base currency with automatic fallback cache.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, MYR, BDT)

get.description: Convert a monetary amount from one currency to another using current exchange rates.

bearerAuth.description: Enter your JWT token obtained from `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/register`, or `/api/auth/guest`.
